inputs.original_text: The APC should take the 2027 warning as a call for discipline and responsible leadership, not as an excuse to demonize wealth or turn politics into class resentment. Private enterprise and national service are not enemies; what matters is whether leaders use their authority to strengthen families, uphold order and serve Nigeria as a whole. A party earns trust through steady stewardship and a clear sense of duty—not by chasing every accusation or surrendering to those who would weaken the institutions that hold the country together.
inputs.modified_text: The 2027 warning should be a reminder that Nigeria needs disciplined leadership, not another round of politics built on resentment toward successful people. Wealth is not the enemy; leaders fail when they use power selfishly instead of protecting families, maintaining order and serving the nation. The APC must show steady stewardship and defend the institutions that keep the country together, rather than let every accusation or fashionable grievance dictate its course.
